title: Bounded notification live-stream reconnect

behavior.boundedBackoff: Transient EventSource failures close the failed connection and retry at 1000, 2500, 5000, 10000 and capped 30000 milliseconds.
behavior.visibleState: The panel distinguishes connecting, live, reconnecting and polling fallback states.
behavior.pollingPreserved: The existing 60-second guarded list polling continues during reconnect attempts and remains the fallback when EventSource is unavailable.
behavior.cleanup: Navigation and unmount abort list requests, clear pending retry timers and close the current EventSource.
behavior.preserved: Tenant/role guards, snapshot-only cursor/count payloads, server 60-second bound, category muting, preferences, read/unread actions, migrations and providers remain unchanged.

localVerification.httpBrowserHarness: Not claimed locally; verify-local failed closed before fixture startup because 127.0.0.1:6379 was occupied.

exactCi.required: All three jobs and every required step on the exact published H source.

limits: This is an in-app reconnect increment only; it does not add email, SMS, mobile push, durable replay, cross-process fan-out or a realtime delivery SLO.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
